text:
Ria: quick ping — PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/8672 needs eyes. Buildkite keeps failing intermittently on `streaming-handler.test.ts::handles-slow-io` for macos-builder. Failing ~1/4 runs. Can someone take a look? :eyes:

Owen: lemme take a look, what's the failing job id? i can rerun if it's a flake

Ria: job: https://buildkite.com/redwood/infra/builds/4201#ef12a3 logs show this error:
```
Error: Timeout waiting for stream drain
at StreamingHandler.handle (/work/streaming-handler.ts:142:23)
at processTicksAndRejections (internal/process/task_queues.js:94:5)
```
It times out after 8s in CI but locally i can't repro reliably.

Buildkite Bot: Build #4201 — job "macos-builder" failed (exit code 1). Retry available.

Maya: if it's nondeterministic we should bisect or add extra logging. Ria, can you `gh pr checkout 8672` and run `yarn test -t streaming-handler --runInBand` locally? might need to increase `--timeout` for debug

Ria: running now, will post logs

Tai: if you want a quick unblock, i can rerun the job and watch. command i use:
```
bk retry --build 4201 --job macos-builder
```

Ria: thanks, Tai — reran once, it passed, reran again and failed. looks flaky. i'm going to add more logs and a short repro snippet in the PR. @Maya can you take lead on bisecting tomorrow? i'll leave a note in the PR with the failing build links.

Maya: yep i'll bisect tomorrow AM. if i can't find a root cause i'll add an xfail and a follow-up ticket. tagging @Owen in case you want to handle a quick CI guard.

Owen: happy to add a guard (skip on macos-builder for now) if bisect doesn't turn anything up. keep me posted.

Ria: thanks all — leaving this thread open. will update thread_ts when i push logs. :thumbsup:
